stacks.name: no-remote-scripts
stacks.notes: Fails if any page loads a script from another origin: genki shares this origin and keeps a token in the browser.

release.notes: Merging to main publishes the site through GitHub Pages; there is no build or deploy step of our own.

notes: Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build, no tests besides the no-remote-scripts check, no auth. /nihongo/ is a separate repo (syoon291/nihongo) served under this domain, not in this repo. /workout/legacy/ is the 2023 team project kept as-is.
